notes.title: "Tales of Xillia Remastered " will be available on Oct 31st, Friday
notes.content:
[h1][b]Two Heroes, One Destiny[/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=feXG0jHLpU8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Announcing the release of “Tales of Xillia Remaster,” the remastered version of “Tales of Xillia,” which was released in 2011 as the 15th anniversary title of the “Tales of” series.

An RPG set in a world where humans and spirits coexist has been remastered for modern consoles, offering stunning graphics and enhanced gameplay. Dive into the magnificent world of Rieze Maxia as either Jude Mathis, an aspiring medical student from the capital, or Milla Maxwell, a mysterious woman accompanied by four powerful spirits.[/h3]

[b]Product Page：[/b]https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/tales-of-xillia-remastered
[b]Official X：[/b]https://x.com/TalesofSeries

[h2][b]• Two Heroes, One Destiny[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/a75b46bdb36183f3628dde08cb8159701cbdf53e.jpg[/img]
Follow the paths of Milla and Jude as they embark on their daring journey through Rieze Maxia, a wondrous land where humans and spirits coexist in harmony.

[h2][b]• Partner Up with Dual Raid[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/d913887cffa78164b3eb3fac7fec6b11c0efff6f.jpg[/img]
Master the Dual Raid Linear Motion Battle System, mustering strategy and coordination to overcome action-packed battles in real-time combat. Team up with allies to unleash devastating combo attacks and unlock special support skills to overwhelm your foes.

[h2][b]・New features added for remaster![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/1aa52fae7891762ac0f91daf4ee4f4616df72858.jpg[/img]
Explore with new quality-of-life updates including improved graphics, an auto-save feature, the ability to toggle encounters, early shop access, and more.


[h2][b]・Pre-order has started![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/b67dca468e044d32518556e7ae7ef469311cea12.png[/img]
Pre-order to receive the Super Adventuring Assistance Set early in your Tales of Xillia Remastered journey.

- Apple Gel x 10
- Orange Gel x 10
- Life Bottle x 10
-Panacea Bottle x 10

[h2][b]・Deluxe Edition is also available![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766530/d9f87ea585df844d94554720f456b66403ebadef.png[/img]
We are now selling the digital download edition of “Deluxe Edition,” which includes luxurious bonus content.
The ‘Deluxe Edition’ includes a ‘Digital Artbook’ featuring extensive setting materials and illustrations, a ‘Digital Soundtrack’ containing all 81 in-game BGM tracks, a ‘Battle BGM pack’ that allows you to replace standard battle music with BGM from previous series installments, and a ‘Super Growth Support Herb Set’ that enhances character parameters.

- Tales of Xillia Remastered
- Battle BGM pack
- Digital Artbook & Soundtrack
- Super Growth Support Herb Set

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2246670/_/

notes.title: RPG worlds collide between Tales of Arise and SCARLET NEXUS ⚔️
notes.content:
[h3]An exciting crossover between [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/740130/Tales_of_Arise/]Tales of Arise[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/775500/SCARLET_NEXUS/]SCARLET NEXUS[/url][/b] is available today, with a [b]free update[/b] bringing [b]new content to both games[/b].[/h3]

In [b]Tales of Arise[/b], players can unleash the power of the mind with the new [b]SCARLET NEXUS[/b]-themed content available in-game, including [b]Myoho Murasama Replica[/b], a [b]new weapon for Alphen[/b], [b]two additional attachments[/b], the [b]Handmade Hair Clip Replica[/b] and [b]Baki[/b], as well as a [b]new battle background music[/b] (BGM) called [b]Opposed Viewpoint[/b]. 

In [b]SCARLET NEXUS[/b], players can challenge the fate that binds them with the new [b]Tales of Arise[/b]-themed content available in-game, including the [b]Blazing Sword for Yuito[/b] alongside the [b]Broken Iron Mask[/b] and [b]Owlet Doll attachments[/b], and new [b]Tales of Arise battle background music[/b] (BGM).

[previewyoutube=wtAmRNalwfg;full][/previewyoutube]
Released in 2021, [b]SCARLET NEXUS[/b] challenges players to take on the role of [b]Yuito Sumeragi[/b] or [b]Kasane Randall[/b] as they team up with a colorful cast of characters to [b]strike down the deranged mutants[/b] known as the [b]Others[/b] with [b]powerful psycho-kinetic abilities[/b] in the [b]futuristic city of New Himuka[/b]. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/740130/Tales_of_Arise/
